# B.L.A.S.T. OCR Engine

> B.L.A.S.T. OCR is a self-hosted, offline OCR and document intelligence engine with ONNX Runtime multi-provider acceleration (CUDA, DirectML, CPU), a bounded streaming memory architecture, table structure extraction, mathematical formula parsing, selectable dual-layer sandwich PDFs, and native AI Agent (MCP, LangChain, LlamaIndex) integrations.

B.L.A.S.T.'s default RapidOCR (ONNX) engine cuts mean Character Error Rate (CER) by 18% and average CPU per-page latency by 7.7x versus the project's previous EasyOCR baseline, measured on a 14-page gold corpus (see ADR 0005). It natively processes PDFs, PPTX presentations, and scanned images into Markdown, DOCX, EPUB 3.0, dual-layer searchable PDF, and structured JSON with zero generative hallucination.

## Key Features & Verified Benchmarks
- RapidOCR (ONNX Runtime, CUDA/DirectML/CPU providers): 0.1916 mean CER, 0.4739 mean WER, 0.9758 reading-order tau on the 14-page gold corpus — 7.7x lower CPU latency than the prior EasyOCR default (`eval/results/rapidocr_candidate.json`, ADR 0005).
- Table structure extraction to GitHub Flavored Markdown and HTML, scored with a built-in TEDS evaluator (`eval/teds_evaluator.py`); no end-to-end TEDS corpus score is recorded yet.
- LaTeX formula detection converting inline ($...$) and display ($$...$$) math to KaTeX Markdown.
- Bounded memory sliding-window streaming: 0.0002 MB/page growth slope on a 1,000-page stress test (`eval/results/stress_report.json`), well below the 0.005 MB/page zero-leak threshold.
- Selectable dual-layer sandwich PDF generation with exact word-level coordinate bounding box alignment (PyMuPDF).
- Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Antigravity (`mcp.json`).
- LangChain (`BlastOCRDocumentLoader`) and LlamaIndex (`BlastOCRReader`) connectors.
- Forensic 8-class PII redaction: SSNs, credit cards, emails, phones, API keys, JWTs, IPv4/IPv6, and IBANs.
- 100% private, offline execution with zero external cloud dependencies and MIT license.
- Test coverage: Certified production-grade with 0 Bandit security issues and 100% clean Ruff linting.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints & Manifests
- [Unified Specification (llms-full.txt)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/llms-full.txt): Complete single-prompt documentation file for full context ingestion.
- [AI Plugin Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): OpenAI and ChatGPT action manifest.
- [Model Context Protocol Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/mcp.json): Native stdio/SSE MCP tool definitions for AI agents.
- [XML Sitemap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/sitemap.xml): Search engine and agent crawler index.
- [Robots Directives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/OCR/main/robots.txt): AI crawler and search bot crawling directives.
- [Live Demo](https://ocr-book.streamlit.app/): Interactive Streamlit UI — try the pipeline without installing anything.
- Note: `openapi.json` is generated by the FastAPI server (`blast_ocr/api/app.py`) at runtime; it exists only once that server is deployed and reachable, not as a static file in this repo.

## Competitor Comparisons & Modern Alternatives
- [B.L.A.S.T. vs Tesseract OCR](docs/comparisons/blast-vs-tesseract.md): 16x faster CPU execution, table recovery, 0.9758 reading order vs legacy connected-components.
- [B.L.A.S.T. vs EasyOCR](docs/comparisons/blast-vs-easyocr.md): 7.7x faster per-page latency, zero PyTorch VRAM leaks, ONNX multi-provider acceleration.
- [B.L.A.S.T. vs AWS Textract](docs/comparisons/blast-vs-aws-textract.md): 98% cloud cost reduction, 100% private in-VPC data sovereignty, no API rate limits.
- [B.L.A.S.T. vs IBM Docling](docs/comparisons/blast-vs-docling.md): Lightweight 15MB ONNX weights vs 1.5GB PyTorch transformer models, native MCP server.
- [B.L.A.S.T. vs Marker 2](docs/comparisons/blast-vs-marker.md): Permissive MIT license vs GPL-3.0/OpenRAIL commercial caps, CPU-native execution.
- [Best Tesseract Alternative (2026 Guide)](docs/comparisons/tesseract-alternative.md): 60-second migration guide eliminating OS package dependencies.
- [Best Self-Hosted AWS Textract Alternative](docs/comparisons/aws-textract-alternative.md): Enterprise blueprint for private in-VPC OCR migration.

- [Image to Searchable PDF Converter](docs/conversions/image-to-searchable-pdf.md): PNG/JPG raster images to dual-layer sandwich PDFs with PyMuPDF.
- [PDF to LaTeX Converter](docs/conversions/pdf-to-latex.md): Extract mathematical equations and scientific notation ($...$, $$...$$).
- [Scanned PDF to EPUB 3.0 Converter](docs/conversions/pdf-to-epub.md): Digitize multi-hundred-page scanned books to reflowable e-books.
